design_description: best developability of all 20 (drops trastuzumab's DG isomerisation and the CDRH3 tryptophan); plus the stabilising mutation, so all three axes are in play. CDRH3 MGPEPFYAMD, 4 mutations from trastuzumab. VL R66G, dTm +4.9 C measured on trastuzumab scFv (Okazaki 2023).
second-best developability, a distinct loop from tz-opt-02; stabilised. CDRH3 WGGWPAYALD, 4 mutations from trastuzumab. VL R66G, dTm +4.9 C measured on trastuzumab scFv (Okazaki 2023).
removes the DG isomerisation motif, loop distinct from both above; stabilised. CDRH3 FGGWPWYAMD, 4 mutations from trastuzumab. VL R66G, dTm +4.9 C measured on trastuzumab scFv (Okazaki 2023).

fourth design that improves on trastuzumab's liability profile; stabilised, and the most conservative loop of the four. CDRH3 FGGDMWYWMD, 4 mutations from trastuzumab. VL R66G, dTm +4.9 C measured on trastuzumab scFv (Okazaki 2023).

highest-ranked loop under the old binding proxy, kept as a hedge in case that proxy carries signal we could not demonstrate; stabilised. CDRH3 APGDGFQIMD, 4 mutations from trastuzumab. VL R66G, dTm +4.9 C measured on trastuzumab scFv (Okazaki 2023).
second loop from the old binding proxy, same hedge, different sequence; stabilised. CDRH3 LGGDGAYMVD, 4 mutations from trastuzumab. VL R66G, dTm +4.9 C measured on trastuzumab scFv (Okazaki 2023).
